motions: A huge tall thin alien insectoid creature with long scythe blades for forearms slashes horizontally with its right blade arm from right to left, stepping forward
A huge tall thin alien insectoid creature with long scythe blades for forearms slashes back from left to right with its left blade arm, stepping forward
A huge tall thin alien insectoid creature with long scythe blades for forearms raises both blade arms high and brings them down together in a crossing overhead strike
A huge tall thin alien insectoid creature with long scythe blades for forearms lunges forward and snaps both blade arms closed in front of it to grab and pin something
A huge tall thin alien insectoid creature with long scythe blades for forearms quickly sidesteps to its left in a low crouch, keeping its blades raised
A huge tall thin alien insectoid creature with long scythe blades for forearms quickly sidesteps to its right in a low crouch, keeping its blades raised
A huge tall thin alien insectoid creature with long scythe blades for forearms rears up, spreads its blade arms wide and shrieks in a threatening display
A huge tall thin alien insectoid creature with long scythe blades for forearms is hit hard, reels backward off balance with blades flailing, then recovers
A huge tall thin alien insectoid creature with long scythe blades for forearms convulses, collapses to its knees and falls forward onto the ground, motionless
